decisions.reason: The polynomial extension is matrix-valued, not SO(4)-valued: a polynomial SO(4) map on R4 has bounded entries and is constant, whereas L_a is nonconstant. On S3 integer quaternion powers (negative powers represented by conjugate powers) are polynomial, preserve norm, and have determinant +1 by connectedness. Corrected the Remarks only; the metric disk/sphere construction, dimensions, compactness and outward-normal-first orientation remain valid. No Statement or Definition change occurs.

The Pontryagin supplier requires path-connected CW type, but D8 disjoint-union S8 is an allowed filling of S7. Finite CW type alone does not meet that hypothesis. Added an explicit componentwise construction: manifold components are open/path connected, compactness makes them finite and compact, each has finite CW type under the assumed AC, and singular cochains split over components, determining a unique p1(TW). Exactness gives the unique relative lift; the relative cup square is integral and the boundary signature is defined without a connectivity restriction. No filling hypothesis was narrowed.

The cited h-cobordism definition requires a compact smooth triad with homotopy-equivalent face inclusions, not an orientation. The construction already carries an orientation, so that overstatement is nonfatal. Also corrected the unsupported claim that a collar definition supplies product corner smoothing: now cite collar existence and round each quadrant by z>=g(w), with g a convex smoothing of |w| fixed outside a small interval. Raising z to max(z,g(w)) deformation-retracts the contractible product onto the rounded manifold. The punctured-sphere, excision, boundary-degree, van Kampen and finite-model homology Whitehead arguments then give both face homotopy equivalences with the claimed opposite boundary orientations. Statement unchanged.

The local absolute-Hurewicz restatement omitted CW homotopy type, although the actual application supplies finite CW models in step 1.1 and explicitly checks this in step 2.1. Replaced L3 with the supplier’s exact r>=2, (r-1)-connectivity and actual CW-homotopy-equivalence hypotheses. The degree-2 through degree-6 induction is valid, degree-7 Hurewicz represents the oriented homology generator, and finite-model mapping-cylinder relative Hurewicz plus Whitehead proves that generator map is a homotopy equivalence. This is a nonfatal restatement defect; Statement and proof applications are unchanged.

The old gluing supplier applies to entire closed boundary components and cannot justify the diskwise 1-handle of step 2.1. Replaced that dependency and L2 citation with the existing published smooth-handle-attachment definition and collar theorem. Boundary coordinate disks extend to larger disks, meeting the attachment hypothesis; the exposed I times S^(n-1) cylinder yields the standard oriented connected-sum boundary. Positive tangent frames are locally contracted and matched to the product frame on neighborhoods including both foot edges, so their ambient extensions restrict to frames on the rounded region. Representative independence follows from oriented diffeomorphism, and opposite fillings and the disk give inverse and zero. Statement unchanged; no new item is needed.
